_comment: AI-RADAR v1 watchlist. Adding an entity or channel is a data edit, not code. status: verified = live-probed 200 on 2026-07-31 | mechanism_verified = the method works, this specific target not probed | needs_adapter = requires Playwright/HTML extraction | broken = advertises a feed that does not work | dropped = not viable for v1, reason in note.

x_strategy._comment: No account, no cookies. Discovery is allowed to fail; hydration is the reliable part.

hydration.note: Public embed infrastructure. Returns full tweet JSON: text, created_at, favorite_count, entities, media.

discovery.note: Serving fresh posts on 2026-07-31. Instances die often — best-effort only, never a dependency.
Pull x.com/*/status/<id> URLs out of the HN, Reddit and Techmeme feeds already being polled. Zero extra cost, survives Nitter dying.

rejected.reason: Requires user's own X cookies (auth_token + ct0); its own README warns of ban risk and recommends a burner account. Also shaped for interactive agent use, not a 24/7 poller.
Cookie-based; the engine Agent-Reach delegates to.
Advertises 'no login' but proxies to Nitter instances — same fragility, extra dependency.
Require real X account credentials or an account pool.

excluded.name: AI工具集 (ai-bot.cn)
excluded.reason: robots.txt names and blocks the entire AI/aggregator crawler class with Disallow: / — including anthropic-ai, ClaudeBot, Claude-Web, GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, CCBot, cohere-ai, Google-Extended, Bytespider, Diffbot, Scrapy, news-please, NewsNow, omgili. Its WordPress RSS is also deliberately disabled (/feed/ returns 'Feed关闭').
excluded.note: User-agent: * leaves content paths open, so a generic UA would pass the letter of the file — but selecting a UA to slip past a list that names exactly this bot class is evasion, which AGENTS.md forbids. Excluded unless the operator grants written permission.
excluded.alternative: CN coverage in v1 comes from QbitAI RSS plus first-party GitHub/HF release signals, which are earlier than any aggregator anyway.

_known_issues.issue: GitHub org-level activity feeds are empty
_known_issues.detail: https://github.com/<org>.atom returns valid Atom with zero <entry> elements for orgs (verified on deepseek-ai, QwenLM, MoonshotAI, zai-org). They cannot be used to watch a whole org, so per-repo release feeds must be paired with the HF org API.

_known_issues.issue: China-hosted hosts are slow/flaky from outside CN
_known_issues.detail: zhipuai.cn timed out repeatedly at 20-25s. Needs generous timeouts and tolerant failure handling, and belongs in the warm/cold tier rather than hot.
